summary: Patterson-UTI Energy filed an 8-K regarding the completion of a $500 million offering of 6.050% Senior Notes due 2036. The proceeds will redeem its outstanding 3.95% Senior Notes due 2028 and for general corporate purposes. The Notes are senior unsecured obligations issued under an indenture, with interest payable semiannually, maturing May 15, 2036. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. The filing creates a direct financial obligation but does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or any other special-situations category. No deal terms are applicable.
